reason: I'd probably poke at the free plan, but I've already quit Motion and Sunsama and I always end up back in Apple Notes. Nothing here tells me why this one wouldn't go the same way, so I'm not paying $12 a month for it.
objection: The done/push/shrink/drop check-in sounds a lot like Sunsama's shutdown ritual, which I stopped doing after two weeks. Another app asking me questions every hour is exactly what I abandon.
would_change_my_mind: If the free plan let me run the whole drag-to-calendar and roll-forward loop for a month, and I was still using it at the end, I'd think about paying.
